title: Onboarding a product to Go AI gateway token minting: sets that must change together
answers: How do I let a sandbox run product mint an AI gateway token?
Add a new origin product to the Go AI gateway
Why is my product's sandbox run still using the Python LLM gateway?
body:
Enabling a product for Go gateway minting touches several places that must stay in sync:
- `MINTABLE_PRODUCTS` in products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/ai_gateway_token.py (base eligibility).
- `SANDBOX_BOUND_MINTABLE_PRODUCTS` (same file) if the run has no wall-clock cap, so the token lives as long as the sandbox.
- `AI_CREDITS_BILLED_PRODUCTS` (same file) if the Python gateway billed it to AI credits; Go gateway has no credit check so the mint refuses when out of credits.
- `PRODUCT_ALLOWED_MODELS` in products/tasks/backend/logic/services/gateway_model_pin.py (first-party model pin; off-pin models get `model_outside_pin` and stay on the Python gateway).
- `SANDBOX_AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN_CAP_USD_PRODUCT_OVERRIDES` default in posthog/settings/temporal.py (per-run USD cap, e.g. "75").
- Tests in products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/tests/test_ai_gateway_token.py: the parametrized pin/cap cases and the exact-equality `test_ai_credits_billed_products` assertion.
Minting stays inert until the product is listed in the `SANDBOX_AI_GATEWAY_PRODUCTS` env setting (deployed via charts, not in this repo).
applies: Adding or changing a product's eligibility for Go AI gateway tokens in sandbox task runs.
